name: Breakfast Corner
line: Coffee within arm's reach of sugar. Someone has built a breakfast corner, and the office is stronger for it.

name: Lunch Spot
line: Food next to somewhere to sit — that corner just became where lunch happens.

name: Dance Floor
line: Music and party lights in the same corner. That's not decor anymore, that's a dance floor.

name: Tournament Zone
line: Two ways to compete, zero excuses. A bracket is forming as we speak.

name: Arcade Corner
line: Two games side by side. Winner stays on.

name: Green Desk
line: A plant beside the desks. Studies say it helps. The plant says nothing.

name: Deep Rest Nook
line: Something calm beside somewhere soft. Naps in that corner hit different now.

name: Zen Pool
line: Water sounds and stillness together. The most peaceful three square meters in the building.

name: Reading Light
line: Good light over a good chair. Somebody is going to live there.

name: Home Gym
line: Two pieces of exercise gear in one spot — congratulations, the office has a gym now.

name: Listening Lounge
line: Music with somewhere to sink into. The lounge has opinions about your playlist.

name: Gallery Wall
line: Two pieces of art within glancing distance. People are pretending to understand both.

name: Fireside
line: Warmth and a place to sit. Stories will be told there whether anyone plans to or not.

name: Health Kick
line: Healthy snacks beside the wellness corner. Somebody's new year is going great.

name: Movie Night
line: A screen and a seat, aligned. The office has a cinema, population: whoever gets there first.

name: Studio Corner
line: Two creative stations feeding off each other. Ideas are cross-pollinating over there.

name: Sacred Corner
line: The ritual objects found the quiet spot. Whatever happens there now, it's official.

name: Morale Mascot
line: Something ridiculous is watching over the desks, and honestly, output is up.

name: Noise Complaint
line: Somebody put the music next to the quiet corner. The quiet corner has filed a complaint.

name: Distraction Field
line: Party fixtures within sight of the desks. Deadlines are now a spectator sport.

name: Temptation
line: Sweets stationed right beside the workout gear. This office understands irony.

name: Splash Hazard
line: Water feature, meet electronics. Facilities has been notified. Facilities is one guy.
